description:
Outcome: Deployable verified first version, from brief.md First version must 1–4 and Constraints plus owner email decisions
Scope: Production configuration/secrets, email delivery and scheduler setup, backup/restore and retention documentation, phone/keyboard/screen-reader journeys, privacy/security regression, staging smoke evidence and operator runbook. Excludes: map/grid, payments and tool lending
Acceptance: Restore rehearsal succeeds; real sign-in/digest delivery verified in staging; deployment repeatable; revised v1 journeys pass with privacy and allocation evidence
Behaviour: Monitor failed sends/jobs and document recovery; usable error paths verified
Verification: Integration/E2E, manual usability/accessibility checks, staging email delivery and restore rehearsal. Prerequisites: T-007, T-008, T-011. Assumptions: operator supplies hosting/mail accounts and garden calendar/timezone before staging
title: Release verification and operations
